name: Arianism
overview: Arianism denies the full deity of Jesus Christ, but Scripture affirms His divine nature and eternal existence. Isaiah prophesies the coming Messiah as 'The mighty God' and 'The everlasting Father,' confirming His deity. John’s Gospel declares that the Word was both with God and was God from the beginning, and that this Word became flesh in the person of Jesus. Jesus Himself identifies with the eternal 'I AM,' affirming His uncreated, divine nature. These truths uphold the biblical teaching that Jesus Christ is fully God and fully man, eternal and uncreated, countering the Arian view that He is a created being.
